insight: LineageOS foldable/flip support is AOSP DeviceStateManager CONFIGURATION, not custom framework work. The working Razr 40 Ultra port (AmeChanRain/device_motorola_zeekr) implements all fold behavior in 4 XML files under fold/: device_state_configuration.xml declares CLOSED/HALF_OPENED/OPENED/REAR_DISPLAY off com.motorola.sensor.hall plus android.sensor.hinge_angle thresholds, and display_layout_configuration.xml maps which physical display address is defaultDisplay per state. Do not budget framework work for cover displays on Motorola flips.

Motorola-Pineapple/android_device_motorola_sm8650-common LOOKS like a usable common tree but is a stub: BoardConfigCommon.mk sets TARGET_BOARD_PLATFORM := pineapple and references NO kernel, and the repo has no lineage.dependencies file at all. Compare AmeChanRain/device_motorola_sm8475-common which declares 4 kernel repos explicitly. Judge a device tree by whether it wires a kernel, not by whether the repo exists. Same for android_device_motorola_arcfox: 3 commits, no fold/ sepolicy/ overlay-lineage/ rootdir/.

xdaforums.com is behind bunny.net bot protection and returns 403 to BOTH the gstack browse headless browser and WebFetch. Do not burn turns retrying. For Android ROM/device-tree facts, go straight to gh api / gh search repos / gh repo list, which is faster and gives ground truth (branches, commit counts, file listings, README contents via base64 -d). WebSearch works for finding the URLs and codenames.

Motorola arcfox (Razr 50 Ultra) display addresses are local:4630947043778501763 (INNER, port 131, 1080x2640) and local:4630947043778501764 (OUTER, port 132, 1080x1272). zeekr (Razr 40 Ultra) uses ...762 INNER and ...763 OUTER — shifted by one. Copying zeekr fold/display_layout_configuration.xml onto arcfox sets defaultDisplay to a nonexistent ...762 AND disables ...763 which is arcfox inner screen. Silent black-screen boot, no log line names an address. Always read display addresses off the target device via dumpsys display before authoring display_layout_configuration.xml.

com.motorola.sensor.hinge_posture on arcfox reports a SPARSE LADDER of discrete values, verified by physical sweep: {0, 70, 90, 110, 180}. Not continuous, not uniform buckets. A fast closed-to-open motion emitted 0 -> 90 -> 180, skipping 70 and 110. Stock device_state_configuration.xml thresholds are designed around this: HALF_OPENED_QVD [45,90) is reachable by the single value 70. Authoring thresholds against an assumed continuous angle can create silently unreachable device states with nothing in any log. Also: arcfox detects closed via SW_LID on the MotFlip_LID input device, NOT via the hall sensor that zeekr uses.
